transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad for the past two years, and it just isn't getting any better. I finally realized I can't deal with this heavy feeling on my own anymore, so I decided to seek help.
Have you felt depressed most days for at least two years, with any periods of feeling better lasting no more than a couple of months?

Yes, that is exactly how it has been. For the past two years, I have felt down almost every single day without any breaks. I haven't had any periods where I felt genuinely better during this whole time.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Persistent Depressive Disorder, Major Depressive Disorder], but the patient now clearly reports depressed mood most days for two years with no sustained periods of feeling better. That chronic, continuous course supports Persistent Depressive Disorder and makes Major Depressive Disorder less likely because MDD is typically episodic rather than continuously present for two years.
